name: Optimizing multi-task RNN test accuracy on 93 Yang19 tasks

description: Baseline: mean_acc=0.733 with HIDDEN=256, LR=1e-3, EPOCHS=30, BATCH=64
Add train_acc monitoring + data caching. Train acc=0.857 — model is underfitting, not overfitting.

asi.key_finding: train_acc=0.857 — model underfits, need more capacity/epochs
asi.next_action: increase hidden size and epochs to push train acc toward 100%

description: HIDDEN=512, EPOCHS=60: train_acc=0.99, test_acc=0.797. Underfitting solved, now generalization gap.

asi.key_finding: train_acc=0.99 achieved, test=0.797. Generalization gap ~0.19. Match still weakest at 0.60
asi.next_action: add dropout/weight decay for regularization, or try LR schedule

description: Dropout=0.3 + weight_decay=1e-4: test_acc=0.870, match_acc 0.60→0.90. Massive regularization win.

asi.hypothesis: dropout 0.3 + weight decay to close generalization gap
asi.key_finding: test jumped 0.797→0.870. Match family massive improvement 0.60→0.90. DM still weakest at 0.74
asi.next_action: try more epochs, LR schedule, or 2-layer GRU

description: EPOCHS=100 + cosine LR: test_acc=0.906, match=0.98. DM still weakest at 0.76. 320s runtime.

asi.key_finding: test=0.906. DM family is bottleneck at 0.76. Runtime 320s approaching limit.
asi.next_action: focus on DM tasks, try bigger batch or 2-layer GRU, watch runtime

description: 2-layer GRU: test=0.815, worse than 1-layer (0.906). Also slower (437s).

asi.next_action_hint: try bigger batch size or higher LR with 1-layer, or data augmentation

description: Dropout=0.5, batch=128: test=0.902 slightly worse than 0.906. Go improved but DM dropped.

asi.next_action_hint: try dropout 0.4, or AdamW with higher weight decay, or LR=3e-3
